mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening, compressing discount rates and lowering equity present value, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates labor market expansion, boosting consumer demand and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth below -50,000 jobs signals labor market contraction, reducing consumer demand and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production above 102.5 (INDPRO) signals supply-side expansion, lowering inflation pressures and supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO) signals supply-side contraction, raising inflation expectations and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index below 272.265 signals disinflation, lowering growth expectations and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index below 272.265 signals disinflation, lowering growth expectations and compressing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
